STORM OLIVE AND VIOLET: a wide speckled seam where dark olive-grey meets bruise-violet broadening toward the right edge, ordered dot dither filling the blend, three wide bands above and two below, a gentle aurora ripple folded through the violet upper bands

SILVER RIM STORM BANDS: three slate bands above a bright silver-white rim band on the horizon, the bands narrowing from wide near the crown to a thin dark strip at mid-sky, Bayer speckle at every seam, one long thin wisp of high cirrus combed into fine parallel filaments across the uppermost slate band
